````prisma
// Temporary SQLite schema for migration generation
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = "file:./temp.db"
}

// Copy all models from the main schema
model Tenant {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  name         String   @db.VarChar(255)
  slug         String   @unique @db.VarChar(100)
  ownerId      String?  @map("owner_id") @db.Uuid
  platformName String?  @map("platform_name") @db.VarChar(255)
  plan         Plan?    @relation("PlanTenants", fields: [planId], references: [id])
  planId       String?  @map("plan_id") @db.Uuid
  logoUrl      String?  @map("logo_url") @db.Text
  timezone     String   @default("America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires") @db.VarChar(50)
  aiProvider   String?  @map("ai_provider") @db.VarChar(50)
  aiApiKey     String?  @map("ai_api_key") @db.Text
  aiModel      String?  @map("ai_model") @db.VarChar(100)
  twitterAppKey String? @map("twitter_app_key") @db.Text
  twitterAppSecret String? @map("twitter_app_secret") @db.Text
  twitterAccessToken String? @map("twitter_access_token") @db.Text
  twitterAccessSecret String? @map("twitter_access_secret") @db.Text
  googleClientEmail String? @map("google_client_email") @db.Text
  googlePrivateKey String? @map("google_private_key") @db.Text
  googleFolderId String? @map("google_folder_id") @db.Text
  metaAppId    String?  @map("meta_app_id") @db.Text
  metaAppSecret String? @map("meta_app_secret") @db.Text
  metaConfigId String?  @map("meta_config_id") @db.Text
  webhookPipelineUrl String? @map("webhook_pipeline_url") @db.Text
  webhookNuevoBotonUrl String? @map("webhook_nuevo_boton_url") @db.Text
  webhookViejoBotonUrl String? @map("webhook_viejo_boton_url") @db.Text
  webhookTercerBotonUrl String? @map("webhook_tercer_boton_url") @db.Text
  googleSearchApiKey String? @map("google_search_api_key") @db.Text
  googleSearchCx    String? @map("google_search_cx") @db.Text
  stripeCustomerId  String? @map("stripe_customer_id") @db.Text
  stripeSubscriptionId String? @map("stripe_subscription_id") @db.Text
  stripeSubscriptionStatus String? @map("stripe_subscription_status") @db.VarChar(50)
  trialEndsAt       DateTime? @map("trial_ends_at")
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  users             User[]
  pipelines         Pipeline[]
  topics            Topic[]
  articles          Article[]
  publications      Publication[]
  pipelineConfigs   PipelineConfig[]
  connections       Connection[]
  jobs              Job[]
  stripeInvoices    StripeInvoice[]
  credits           Credit[]
}

model User {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  email       String   @unique @db.VarChar(255)
  password    String   @db.VarChar(255)
  fullName    String   @map("full_name") @db.VarChar(255)
  role        Role     @default(VIEWER)
  tenantId    String   @map("tenant_id") @db.Uuid
  emailVerified Boolean @default(false) @map("email_verified")
  verificationToken String? @map("verification_token") @db.Text
  resetToken  String? @map("reset_token") @db.Text
  resetTokenExpiresAt DateTime? @map("reset_token_expires_at")
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  tenant      Tenant   @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id])
  stripeInvoices StripeInvoice[]

  @@index([email])
  @@index([tenantId])
}

model Plan {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  name         String   @unique @db.VarChar(100)
  description  String?  @db.Text
  priceMonthly Float    @map("price_monthly") @default(0)
  priceYearly  Float?   @map("price_yearly")
  stripePriceIdMonthly String? @map("stripe_price_id_monthly") @db.Text
  stripePriceIdYearly  String? @map("stripe_price_id_yearly") @db.Text
  features     Json     // Array de strings en JSON
  maxUsers     Int      @map("max_users") @default(1)
  maxPipelines Int      @map("max_pipelines") @default(3)
  maxTopicsPerMonth Int @map("max_topics_per_month") @default(10)
  maxArticlesPerMonth Int @map("max_articles_per_month") @default(10)
  maxPublicationsPerMonth Int @map("max_publications_per_month") @default(10)
  maxStorageGb  Float   @map("max_storage_gb") @default(1)
  hasPrioritySupport Boolean @default(false) @map("has_priority_support")
  hasCustomBranding Boolean @default(false) @map("has_custom_branding")
  hasAdvancedAnalytics Boolean @default(false) @map("has_advanced_analytics")
  isActive     Boolean  @default(true) @map("is_active")
  isPublic     Boolean  @default(true) @map("is_public")
  displayOrder Int      @default(0) @map("display_order")
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  tenants      Tenant[] @relation("PlanTenants")
}

model Pipeline {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  tenantId    String   @map("tenant_id") @db.Uuid
  name        String   @db.VarChar(255)
  description String?  @db.Text
  config      Json     // PipelineConfig JSON
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true) @map("is_active")
  isTemplate  Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_template")
  lastRunAt   DateTime? @map("last_run_at")
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  tenant      Tenant   @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id])
  jobs        Job[]

  @@index([tenantId])
}

model Topic {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  tenantId    String   @map("tenant_id") @db.Uuid
  title       String   @db.VarChar(500)
  description String?  @db.Text
  url         String?  @db.Text
  source      String?  @db.VarChar(100)
  category    String?  @db.VarChar(100)
  sentiment   Float?   @default(0)
  urgency     Float?   @default(0)
  isProcessed Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_processed")
  processedAt DateTime? @map("processed_at")
  metadata    Json?    // JSON adicional
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  tenant      Tenant   @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id])
  articles    Article[]

  @@index([tenantId])
  @@index([isProcessed])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

model Article {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  tenantId    String   @map("tenant_id") @db.Uuid
  topicId     String?  @map("topic_id") @db.Uuid
  title       String   @db.VarChar(500)
  content     String   @db.Text
  summary     String?  @db.Text
  author      String?  @db.VarChar(255)
  tags        String?  @db.Text // CSV de tags
  language    String   @default("es") @db.VarChar(10)
  wordCount   Int      @default(0) @map("word_count")
  readingTime Int      @default(0) @map("reading_time") // en minutos
  status      ArticleStatus @default(DRAFT)
  publishedAt DateTime? @map("published_at")
  imageUrl    String?  @map("image_url") @db.Text
  imagePrompt String?  @map("image_prompt") @db.Text
  metadata    Json?    // JSON adicional
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  tenant      Tenant   @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id])
  topic       Topic?   @relation(fields: [topicId], references: [id])
  publications Publication[]

  @@index([tenantId])
  @@index([topicId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

model Publication {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  tenantId    String   @map("tenant_id") @db.Uuid
  articleId   String   @map("article_id") @db.Uuid
  platform    PublicationPlatform
  platformId  String?  @map("platform_id") @db.Text // ID en la plataforma externa
  url         String?  @db.Text
  status      PublicationStatus @default(PENDING)
  scheduledAt DateTime? @map("scheduled_at")
  publishedAt DateTime? @map("published_at")
  error       String?  @db.Text
  metadata    Json?    // JSON respuesta de la plataforma
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  tenant      Tenant   @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id])
  article     Article  @relation(fields: [articleId], references: [id])

  @@index([tenantId])
  @@index([articleId])
  @@index([platform])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([scheduledAt])
}

model PipelineConfig {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  tenantId    String   @map("tenant_id") @db.Uuid
  name        String   @db.VarChar(255)
  config      Json     // PipelineConfig JSON
  isDefault   Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_default")
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  tenant      Tenant   @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id])

  @@index([tenantId])
  @@index([isDefault])
}

model Connection {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  tenantId    String   @map("tenant_id") @db.Uuid
  platform    ConnectionPlatform
  name        String   @db.VarChar(255)
  credentials String   @db.Text // Encriptado
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true) @map("is_active")
  lastTestedAt DateTime? @map("last_tested_at")
  lastError   String?  @map("last_error") @db.Text
  metadata    Json?    // JSON adicional
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  tenant      Tenant   @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id])

  @@index([tenantId])
  @@index([platform])
  @@index([isActive])
}

model Job {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  tenantId    String   @map("tenant_id") @db.Uuid
  pipelineId  String?  @map("pipeline_id") @db.Uuid
  type        JobType
  status      JobStatus @default(PENDING)
  input       Json?    // JSON de entrada
  output      Json?    // JSON de resultado
  progress    Float?   @default(0)
  error       String?  @db.Text
  startedAt   DateTime? @map("started_at")
  completedAt DateTime? @map("completed_at")
  metadata    Json?    // JSON adicional
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  tenant      Tenant   @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id])
  pipeline    Pipeline? @relation(fields: [pipelineId], references: [id])

  @@index([tenantId])
  @@index([pipelineId])
  @@index([type])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

model StripeInvoice {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  tenantId    String   @map("tenant_id") @db.Uuid
  userId      String?  @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  stripeInvoiceId String @unique @map("stripe_invoice_id") @db.Text
  amount      Float    @default(0)
  currency    String   @default("usd") @db.VarChar(3)
  status      String   @db.VarChar(50) // paid, unpaid, void, etc.
  pdfUrl      String?  @map("pdf_url") @db.Text
  hostedInvoiceUrl String? @map("hosted_invoice_url") @db.Text
  invoiceAt   DateTime @map("invoice_at")
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  tenant      Tenant   @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id])
  user        User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])

  @@index([tenantId])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([stripeInvoiceId])
  @@index([invoiceAt])
}

model Credit {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  tenantId    String   @map("tenant_id") @db.Uuid
  type        CreditType
  amount      Int      @default(0)
  description String?  @db.Text
  expiresAt   DateTime? @map("expires_at")
  isUsed      Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_used")
  usedAt      DateTime? @map("used_at")
  metadata    Json?    // JSON adicional
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  tenant      Tenant   @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id])

  @@index([tenantId])
  @@index([type])
  @@index([isUsed])
  @@index([expiresAt])
}

// =============================================
// ENUMS

enum Role {
  OWNER
  EDITOR
  VIEWER
}

enum ArticleStatus {
  DRAFT
  REVIEW
  APPROVED
  PUBLISHED
  ARCHIVED
}

enum PublicationPlatform {
  TWITTER
  FACEBOOK
  INSTAGRAM
  GOOGLE_DRIVE
  WEBHOOK
}

enum PublicationStatus {
  PENDING
  SCHEDULED
  PUBLISHING
  PUBLISHED
  FAILED
  CANCELLED
}

enum ConnectionPlatform {
  TWITTER
  FACEBOOK
  INSTAGRAM
  GOOGLE_DRIVE
  WEBHOOK
}

enum JobType {
  CAPTURE
  TRANSCRIPTION
  TOPIC_DETECTION
  ARTICLE_GENERATION
  IMAGE_GENERATION
  PUBLICATION
  PIPELINE_EXECUTION
}

enum JobStatus {
  PENDING
  RUNNING
  COMPLETED
  FAILED
  CANCELLED
}

enum CreditType {
  ARTICLE
  PUBLICATION
  TRANSCRIPTION
  STORAGE
````

## File: README.md
````markdown
# PeriodistApp

Plataforma SaaS de generacion automatizada de contenido periodistico a partir de transmisiones en vivo. Captura audio de streams (YouTube, Twitch, Kick, Facebook Live), transcribe, detecta temas, investiga en la web, genera articulos y los publica automaticamente en multiples plataformas.

## Stack

- **Backend**: Node.js + TypeScript + Express + Socket.IO + Prisma ORM + PostgreSQL
- **Frontend**: React 19 + Vite + React Router v7 + XYFlow (pipeline editor)
- **IA**: DeepSeek (LLM principal), Google Gemini (fallback + Grounded Search), Grok (imagenes)
- **Media**: yt-dlp (captura), Whisper (transcripcion), Sharp + @napi-rs/canvas (graficos)
- **Publicacion**: Twitter API, Meta API (Facebook/Instagram), Google Drive, Webhooks

## Pipeline Autonomo (10 pasos)

1. **Captura de Audio** - yt-dlp conecta al stream en vivo
2. **Transcripcion** - Whisper convierte audio a texto
3. **Analisis de Temas** - IA segmenta y detecta temas completados (confirmacion 2 fases)
4. **Extraccion de Insights** - Personas, datos clave, queries de busqueda
5. **Investigacion Web** - Gemini Grounded Search + Google CSE
6. **Generacion de Nota** - Articulo con 4 tonos x 4 estructuras
7. **Generacion de Titulo** - Titular periodistico optimizado
8. **Creacion de Placa** - Flyer 1080x1080 con overlay
9. **Publicacion Multi-plataforma** - Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, Drive, Webhooks
10. **Deduplicacion** - Evita notas duplicadas por similitud semantica

## Setup

```bash
# Instalar dependencias
npm install

# Configurar variables de entorno
cp .env.example .env
# Editar .env con tus API keys

# Inicializar base de datos
npx prisma migrate dev
npx prisma db seed

# Desarrollo
npm run dev

# Produccion
npm run build:client
npm start
```

```env

DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:pass@localhost:5432/periodistapp

# Auth
JWT_SECRET=tu-secret-seguro
FRONTEND_URL=http://localhost:5173

# IA (al menos 1 requerido)
DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=
GEMINI_API_KEY=
XAI_API_KEY=

# Seguridad
ENCRYPTION_KEY=

# Twitter
TWITTER_APP_KEY=
TWITTER_APP_SECRET=
TWITTER_ACCESS_TOKEN=
TWITTER_ACCESS_SECRET=

# Meta (Facebook/Instagram)
META_APP_ID=
META_APP_SECRET=
META_CONFIG_ID=

# Google (Drive + Search)
GOOGLE_CLIENT_EMAIL=
GOOGLE_PRIVATE_KEY=
GOOGLE_FOLDER_ID=
GOOGLE_SEARCH_API_KEY=
GOOGLE_SEARCH_CX=

# Email (SMTP)

SMTP_USER=

## Estructura del Proyecto

```
src/
  server/
    index.ts              # Entry point Express + Socket.IO
    lib/
      prisma.ts           # Prisma Client singleton
    middleware/
      auth.ts             # JWT auth + role guard
    routes/
      auth.ts             # Registro, login, verificacion
      pipeline.ts         # Control del pipeline
      agents.ts           # CRUD agentes custom
      meta.ts             # OAuth Meta
      history.ts          # Publicaciones y transcripciones
      settings.ts         # Configuracion
      generate.ts         # Generacion manual
    services/
      authService.ts      # Registro, login, JWT, password reset
      emailService.ts     # Envio de emails SMTP
      pipelineService.ts  # AutoPipeline (orquestador)
      aiService.ts        # LLM wrapper (DeepSeek/Gemini)
      newsService.ts      # Generacion de articulos
      searchService.ts    # Investigacion web
      imageService.ts     # Procesamiento de imagenes
      ...
  client/
    App.tsx               # React SPA principal
    editor/               # Pipeline Visual Editor (XYFlow)
    hooks/                # useSocket, usePipelineState
  shared/
    types.ts              # Tipos compartidos
prisma/
  schema.prisma           # Schema de base de datos
  seed.ts                 # Datos iniciales (planes)
```
````
